description: Which items go together in real transactions: frequent itemsets and rules "A → B" with support, confidence and LIFT (Apriori), sorted by lift so the "everyone buys bread" trap does not top the list. Reads one basket per line (items separated by commas) or the long format every shop or database exports (one row per order line: order id, product). Prefer `path`: the transactions then never enter the conversation. Deterministic.

data.description: The baskets pasted. Alternative to path

format.description: baskets: one basket per line, items separated by , ; or tab. long: a CSV with a header, one row per (transaction, item)

itemColumn.description: long: the item/product column (default: the second)

minSupport.description: Minimum share of baskets an itemset must appear in

path.description: Path to the file. Alternative to data

transactionColumn.description: long: the transaction/order id column (default: the first)

name: market_basket
title: Market-basket analysis: items bought together and association rules with lift
